decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core yogurt business, but it has not appeared on the website since 2019 and flavored variants rotate often, so some risk of delisting remains.
The Abendbrotkäse was positioned as a flagship of the cheese range and is likely established with retailers, though it has had little website visibility since 2019.
A basic semi-hard cheese wheel is a stable staple of an organic cheese assortment and is unlikely to be removed.
The spicy cheese line may see weaker variants trimmed, but the line as a whole probably stays in the range.
The mild creamy soft cheese has mainstream appeal, but soft cheeses have already proven vulnerable, as with Product F, so a moderate risk remains.
